articles.title: Damning Review Exposes Deep Failings in UK Maternity Care
articles.summary: A government-ordered review found racism and discrimination are embedded in NHS maternity services, failing women and babies. The government pledged 1,000 new midwife posts and £41m for facilities, but some families call the response a "missed opportunity."

articles.title: Supreme Court Blocks Trump's Bid to End Birthright Citizenship
articles.summary: In a 6-3 ruling, the Supreme Court affirmed that the 14th Amendment guarantees citizenship to all born on U.S. soil, rejecting Trump's executive order. The decision is a major blow to his immigration agenda and was hailed by civil rights advocates.

articles.title: Record-Breaking Heat Wave Threatens Millions Ahead of July Fourth
articles.summary: Over 100 million Americans face extreme heat warnings as a heat dome pushes temperatures to 105°F across the Midwest and East Coast. The National Weather Service warns of dangerous conditions, especially for vulnerable groups, with climate change making such events more frequent.
